metadata.disclaimer: Curated public bus timetable and frequency guide for Vaishno Devi pilgrimage corridors. All services operate as public stage carriages or interstate scheduled services. Timings, frequencies, and fares are governed by published STA tariff notifications, reciprocal inter-state agreements, and carrier-published commercial tariffs. Real-time GPS location and dynamic seat reservation are not available.

metadata.audit_notes: Phase 6.2 Audit: Corrected unsupported source-verification claims in Phase 6.1. 24 records fully verified with route-specific official gazette/portal schedules. 9 records partially verified (including JKRTC Delhi-to-Katra and Pathankot-to-Katra where official timetables cover Jammu rather than direct Katra, multi-leg connecting routes with estimated layovers, ad-hoc pilgrim railhead shuttles, and seasonal mountain corridors). Removed local Kishtwar circular S.O. 126 from unrelated intercity corridors. Replaced domain-only URLs with route-specific URLs. 0 unverified records.

schedules.departure_window: Morning departure from Srinagar arriving Katra in the evening
schedules.fare_disclaimer: Combined fare is the sum of Leg 1 (Srinagar–Jammu: ₹450–₹650) and Leg 2 (Jammu–Katra: ₹75–₹95). This is NOT a direct through service. Devotees must change buses at Jammu General Bus Stand.
schedules.bus_type: Deluxe Highway Coach (Leg 1) + Express Stage Carriage (Leg 2)
schedules.availability_source: Srinagar TRC Counter & Jammu GBS Counter
schedules.source_circular_reference: Connecting Route Notice SXR-JMU-KTR via Jammu GBS Transfer Hub
schedules.notes: Multi-leg connecting journey via Jammu GBS; 60-min layover is an estimated transfer buffer rather than a single timetabled through-service. Essential connecting journey linking the Kashmir Valley to Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine base via Jammu hub.

leg1.service_type: Daytime Deluxe Highway Coach via Banihal
